original_client_text.markup_text:
I'm 55, and these are the 7 BORING habits that completely changed how I look and feel. 🤍✨

Nothing expensive. Nothing extreme. Just simple things I wish I'd started doing in my 40s!

Ladies, sometimes the biggest transformations come from the smallest changes. 👇

1️⃣ I WALK EVERY SINGLE DAY 🚶‍♀️
30–45 minutes of fresh air, sunshine and movement. It's become my favourite way to clear my head.

2️⃣ I PRIORITISE PROTEIN 🥚
I stopped skipping meals and started eating to support my muscles, energy and recovery.

3️⃣ I LIFT WEIGHTS 💪
Not to get skinny. To stay strong, maintain muscle and feel confident in my body after 50.

4️⃣ I PROTECT MY SLEEP 😴
7–9 hours whenever possible. No skincare routine can replace proper rest!

5️⃣ I WEAR SPF EVERY DAY ☀️
One of the simplest things you can do to protect your skin and prevent premature ageing.

6️⃣ I STOPPED CHASING QUICK FIXES 🌿
No crash diets, miracle detoxes or ridiculous routines. Just consistency with the basics.

7️⃣ I FINALLY PUT MYSELF FIRST ❤️
Less people-pleasing, more boundaries and making time for things that genuinely make me happy.

And here's what I've learned…

You don't need to look 25 to feel beautiful at 55.

You just need to start taking care of the woman you're becoming. 🥹🤍

It's never too late to start.

💬 Comment "HABITS" if you're ready to make yourself a priority!

📌 Save this for later.
🤍 Follow @mayamorettijourney for wellness, fitness and confidence after 40.

#Womenover550 #healthyaging #over50 #selfcareafter40 #summerdress
